title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-69p2: test vectors stale for new wire format
description:
## Bug: Integration test vectors do not match new wire format

**Location:** `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs:206`

The test `shared_vectors_drive_production_implementations` fails because the wire bytes in `test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json` were not regenerated for the new (unshifted) encoding format.

The JSON file declares `"format_version": 2` and the test asserts `format_version == 2`, but the wire byte sequences still contain the old bit-shift-by-1 encoding.

**Specific failure:**
For fragment `tile_0` of `recover_missing_regular_tile`:
- New code produces: `[0x78, 0x3e, 0x00, ...]` (byte 1 = 62, unshifted)
- Test vector expects: `[0x78, 0x7c, 0x00, ...]` (byte 1 = 124, left-shifted-by-1)
- `0x3e = 0b0011_1110` → FCN=62, window=0 (correct, new format)
- `0x7c = 0b0111_1100` → old format had shift-left-by-1

All fragment wire bytes and ACK wire bytes need regeneration.

**Fix:** Regenerate all wire byte sequences in `test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json` using the new unshifted encoding. The Python reference implementation at `python/src/lichen/schc/` may need the same encoding update.
